items.title: Busy calendar leaves NCL short of national team stars
items.summary: The Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) on Friday announced all eight squads for the upcoming National Cricket League (NCL) 2026-27, which is scheduled to begin on October 3.

items.title: Amite experiment comes at Sylhet’s expense
items.summary: Amite is at the centre of Bangladesh’s latest experiment to find a right-handed Test opener. Whether the trial produces a long-term answer remains to be seen, but Sylhet are already paying the price for it.

items.title: ‘50% is mind game’: Mushtaq’s blueprint for next generation of spinners
items.summary: Speaking after a specialist three-day spin-bowling workshop at the Sher-e-Bangla National Cricket Stadium in Mirpur, Mushtaq highlighted the importance of developing a repeatable bowling action through biomechanical analysis, particularly before young spinners reach first-class cricket.

items.title: Litton: 'Playing Asian Games is a rare occurence'
items.summary: The Bangladesh captain is excited for his first Asiad, and said they aim to add to their gold-medal tally this time

items.title: Aliss replaces Saifuddin in Asian Games squad
items.summary: Aliss has yet to make his senior international debut for Bangladesh.

items.title: Fatima Sana and Umm-e-Hani secure bronze for Pakistan in Asian Games
items.summary: Bangladesh were in control of proceedings for the first half of Pakistan's innings, but lost their grip once Fatima Sana got going and never found it again
